audioOutput.title: Audio output
audioOutput.previewHint: Used to listen to a track in its settings, for example headphones, so that a preview never goes out on the PA.

keyBindings.title: Controls
keyBindings.previous: Previous item / back to the start of the track

updates.title: Updates
updates.blockedDuringShow: Can't install while show mode is on or a track is playing.

playback.title: Playback
playback.crossfadeHint: 0 to turn it off. The next track starts while the previous one fades out; a pause keeps its silence.
playback.protectStop: Protect Stop: press twice to stop
playback.protectStopHint: Keeps a reflex press on the Stop key from cutting the show. The emergency fade still works with a single press.
